notes: Web search ran out after 15 searches (the session's shared limit of 200). These candidates were never searched for and were looked up only on guessed county addresses, so a blank for them means 'not looked for' rather than 'not found': Jonathan J Waldner, Jessy C. Biggins, Greg Palmer, Thomas J. Oliva, Tucker Amiotte, Paula Barrick, Brian Kraus, Jason Bender, Lonnie Schultz, Garnet G Paulsen, Tye Kenneth Vander Vorst, Josh Starzman, Kyra Willcuts, Peggy F Ustad, Gary Allen Cudmore.
Sam Marty: SDPB's candidate page links www.samforsd.com as his campaign website, but the site answered HTTP 526 on every try, so it is not recorded.
Jeff Bathke and Roger DeGroot: SDPB's candidate pages give only a Facebook page as the campaign website; a social profile is not a campaign website, so none is recorded.

Frank Kloucek: no campaign website was found. Wikipedia's birth date for him carries no citation, so no birth year is recorded. Wikipedia's infobox and its text give different years for his House and Senate service; the text's version is recorded (it adds to the 16 Senate and 6 House years news reports give) and a verifier should check it. No endorsement page on the South Dakota Democratic Party's own site was found (sddp.org's home page does not name him), so his convention nomination is not recorded under endorsed_by.
Drew Dennert: Wikipedia's birth date carries no citation, so no birth year is recorded; drewdennert.com (named on Wikipedia) did not resolve.

Hughes County's Finance Officer page and Moody County's and Custer County's commissioner pages do not name Thomas J. Oliva, Garnet G Paulsen or Marty W Mechaley in the text a script receives; Gregory County's pages do not name Jessy C. Biggins.
Susan Urban (Aurora County) and Lindell Don Adair (Bennett County): no county page could be reached; search summaries alone are not recorded.
The Legislature's own record answers at https://sdlegislature.gov/api/Historical/Member/<id> (birth date and years of service); the ids for Kloucek and Dennert were not found.
